context: Guards that the Step 4g verification actually reads blocks/header/header.js's welcome-header (header:no) path and catches two live defects there: a hardcoded base-brand icon class/file, and a bare href="/" never run through localizePath(). Fixture header.js has both regressions; the agent must detect and fix them, not assume this file is out of scope because Step 4 only documents header.css.

checklist.name: Identifies the hardcoded base-brand icon reference from the actual file
checklist.description: The agent reads blocks/header/header.js and states that the welcome-header block hardcodes the base brand's icon class (icon-frescopa-icon) and icon file (frescopa-icon.svg), not the company's.

checklist.name: Identifies the bare href="/" as not localized
checklist.description: The agent states that the welcome-header home link is a bare href="/" never passed through localizePath(), unlike other links in the same file, and that this breaks navigation on a foldered demo.

checklist.name: Fixes the home link to resolve via localizePath()
checklist.description: blocks/header/header.js no longer sets the welcome-header home link to a bare "/" literal — it resolves through localizePath('/') or an equivalent non-literal expression.

checklist.name: Removes the hardcoded base-brand icon reference
checklist.description: blocks/header/header.js no longer references frescopa-icon anywhere in the welcome-header block.

checklist.name: Plain language, no internal terms
checklist.description: No internal terms are surfaced unnecessarily to the customer (I1).
